A-3. Inspection - Random samples selected as in A-2 shall be inspected for tolerances, workmanship, free rotation and against corrosion as per requirements in this specification. Needle rollers from these samples shall be tested to IS : 4217-1981 `Specification for needle rollers (first revision )`. Any needle bearing failing to meet the requirement for any one or more of the above characteristics shall be declared as defective. A-4.
